pages.text: Yesterday, Taro and Mumu had agreed to meet at the well tree in the morning. Today, they were going to the sandy shore.
"They say there are lots of shells!" Taro could hardly sleep that night. He wanted to hurry there and collect them.
Mumu arrived at the well tree first. Taro did not come, even after a long wait. "Is he sick?"
Mumu went to Taro's house. No one was on the porch. Inside, Taro's Mom was preparing a meal.
Just then, Taro arrived at the well tree. No one was there. "Did Mumu leave already, or haven't they come yet?"
Taro went to Mumu's house. No one was on the porch. Inside, Mumu's Grandma was preparing a meal.
"Have some food before you go." Mumu's Grandma put a bowl in front of Taro. He picked up a spoon.
"Have some food before you go." Taro's Mom put a bowl in front of Mumu. Mumu picked up a spoon.
Taro ate on Mumu's porch. Mumu ate on Taro's porch. Both looked out at the road.
They met face to face in the middle of the road, still holding their bowls. The sandy shore was right over there. But their bellies were too full for bounding along.
